selection_rule: Two independently certified near-critical normal-state collapses and two independently certified weak-sheet branch inaccuracies, each with branch error at least twenty times the threshold and runtime below one CPU second in the initial probe. Retain all prior large-grid cases; do not inflate dimensions.
public_baseline: Byte-identical original public weak baseline and workspace starting solve.py; previous fresh code is privileged only.
scope: Same finite-cutoff equations, sign convention, quality gates, resources, and score thresholds. Extend physical parameters to closer-to-critical sheet instabilities, weak positive intersheet links down to 1e-12, and nonzero intraband Coulomb repulsion causing frequency sign changes.
phonon_quadrature_fallback: Not pursued: the existing conditioning search already produced robust certified accuracy/branch failures.
